name: Dynamic
description: Input-timing analyzer that helps spot botted or macro-injected runs by comparing hardware input timing to in-game clicks.

show-hud.name: Show live HUD
show-hud.description: Show a small live readout of click statistics while playing.

show-popup.name: Show report on completion
show-popup.description: Show the analysis report in a popup when you complete a level.

save-reports.name: Save reports to disk
save-reports.description: Write a text report into the mod's save folder (reports/) after each completion.

ignore-practice.name: Ignore practice mode
ignore-practice.description: Do not analyze or report runs made in practice mode.

min-clicks.name: Minimum clicks for verdict
min-clicks.description: A run needs at least this many clicks before statistical flags are raised.

input-window-ms.name: Input match window (ms)
input-window-ms.description: How old a hardware input may be and still be matched to an in-game click.
